prompt:
Create one subject-only editorial illustration for a premium packaging-engineering article thumbnail.

Visual language: cinematic three-dimensional industrial product rendering; physically plausible scale and perspective; clean corrugated cardboard, painted steel, timber pallet, and cargo materials where applicable; crisp controlled edges; realistic contact shadows; restrained glossy studio floor; directional key light with soft teal rim light; deep near-black and teal atmosphere compatible with later compositing.

Composition: keep all meaningful subject matter in the right half of a 16:9 frame; preserve the entire left 46 percent as calm, dark negative space; use a three-quarter or isometric-like camera; one coherent scene; strong silhouette; readable at small card size.

The final card renderer adds every word and all branding. Generate no text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, screens, watermarks, people, decorative infographic elements, charts, UI fragments, or clutter. Do not imply that an illustrative arrangement is an exact solver output.

Scene-family direction: Two clearly separated physical subjects with matching scale and one calm visual distinction; never use interface screenshots.
Article-specific subject: two equally scaled timber pallets carrying tidy natural-corrugated carton loads of equal overall capacity but with visibly different plausible layer patterns; conceptual comparison with no exact visibly countable total
Allowed physical subjects: pallet, corrugated_box
Camera: matched three-quarter isometric-like studio view of two side-by-side pallet loads
Materials: warm natural corrugated cartons, restrained timber pallets, clean premium miniature industrial finish
Lighting: one cinematic soft key light from upper left, teal rim light, subtle warm carton highlights, matching controlled shadows
Blending strategy: transparent_alpha
Additional exclusions: text, letters, numbers, logos, vendor branding, people, screenshots, watermarks, visible exact carton count, winner badges, charts, clutter

Use the attached approved nine-tile KolliLabs board only as the visual style reference. Produce exactly one subject-only cutout for the two-pallet comparison card, not a finished thumbnail and not a collage. Preserve clean alpha around the physical scene. Do not reproduce any board text, logo, border, panel, background, or layout.
rollback_target: Existing published article thumbnail/front matter remain unchanged.
